topic: Petra, Jordan: the Nabataeans carved a whole city, including the famous Treasury building, straight into pink sandstone cliffs.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: Petra’s Pink Stone Secret

shots.narration: Golden sparkles! Pink cliffs! Where have we landed?
shots.scene: Ancient Petra, Jordan, towering pink sandstone cliffs, bright sunlight, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya materializes beside Tock inside a swirling cloud of golden time-jump sparkles.
shots.mood: Brilliant blue watch glow, sparkling golden dust, wide-eyed wonder.

shots.narration: It's Petra, Jordan, in the time of the Nabataeans.
shots.scene: A sandy path between Petra's pink sandstone cliffs, warm sunlight, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya slowly turns toward the towering cliffs.
shots.mood: Sunlit pink rock, tiny travelers beneath enormous cliffs, friendly adventure.

shots.narration: [excited] They carved buildings straight into these pink sandstone cliffs!
shots.scene: Petra cliffside with carved ancient doorways opening directly into pink sandstone, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no inscriptions.
shots.action: Tock points one tiny leg toward a doorway carved into the cliff.
shots.mood: Warm rose-colored stone, crisp carved edges, delighted discovery.

shots.narration: But where is the famous Treasury?
shots.scene: A bend in Petra's narrow sandstone passage, high pink walls obscuring the view ahead, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya shades her eyes while peering around the bend.
shots.mood: Curious expression, deep passage shadows, bright sunlight overhead.

shots.narration: These tall walls hide everything ahead.
shots.scene: Inside Petra's winding sandstone passage, close towering rock walls and a sandy floor, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya walks carefully along the passage.
shots.mood: Small yellow hoodie against immense pink walls, gentle suspense.

shots.narration: [whispers] Wait! There's something through that gap.
shots.scene: A narrow opening between Petra's shaded rock walls reveals a sliver of sunlit carved stone, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.mood: Bright golden glimpse beyond cool shadows, eager curiosity.

shots.narration: Zoya follows the sunlight around the corner.
shots.scene: The final bend of Petra's narrow passage, with the Treasury partly visible beyond, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya steps around the sandstone corner.
shots.mood: Warm light spills across the sand, anticipation turning to wonder.

shots.scene: Petra's famous Treasury facade, recognizable carved columns and pediments within the pink sandstone cliff, empty sandy forecourt, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya spreads her arms toward the towering Treasury.
shots.mood: Magnificent rose-colored facade, bright sunlight, joyful reveal.

shots.narration: [surprised] Even this grand building was carved into the cliff!
shots.scene: The Treasury's carved facade meeting the surrounding natural pink sandstone, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no inscriptions.
shots.action: Tock tilts his round glass face upward.
shots.mood: Tiny brass robot beneath immense stone columns, sparkling amazement.

shots.narration: The Nabataeans made the cliff itself their masterpiece.
shots.scene: A side view of the Treasury showing carved architectural details emerging from the sandstone cliff, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya traces the carved outline in the air with her finger.
shots.mood: Respectful admiration, warm pink stone, intricate sunlit carving.

shots.narration: Mystery solved, and a pink stone wonder discovered!
shots.scene: Petra's Treasury forecourt, glowing pink facade behind the travelers, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya raises her glowing blue wristwatch.
shots.mood: Satisfied smiles, blue watch light, gathering golden sparkles.

shots.scene: Petra's Treasury framed by pink cliffs, golden time-travel sparkles filling the foreground, vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Tock turns his glass face toward Zoya to ask his question.
shots.mood: Bouncy anticipation, warm brass reflections, a bright blue watch glow.

episode.endHook: Where will Zoya’s glowing watch take them next?
episode.description: Zoya and Tock time-jump to ancient Petra, Jordan, where a winding passage hides an amazing discovery. Explore pink sandstone cliffs and the famous Treasury carved by the Nabataeans!
